game_start.intro: Súka ya mabé ezalí. Ngunza: {trump_suit} (kárti ya ngunza: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Oyo ozalí Mokonzi {player_id} na German Whist.
{phase_info}
Oyo ozalí na {hand_size} kárti.
Kozwama kárti na '[play N]', wapi N ezalí nzinga ya kárti na bomwana (kama '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Esika ya kotya karte ezali te - ntango ya kosakana ebandi.
next_card.deck_empty: Etando ya bakɔpɔ ezali mpamba - mokanda moko te epesami.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na lolenge ya libunga, salela '[play N]' mpo na kobeta ndembo N-te oyo ozali na yango.
invalid_move.bad_position: Esika yango ezali te. Ozali na bakarte {hand_size} .
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Osengeli kolanda ndakisa na ye mpe kobeta karte {lead_suit}.

trick.won: Mosani {winner_id} alongi na lisano ya mayele oyo ezali na nkombo {card}.
trick.won_learning: Mokonzi {winner_id} akomí kárti na {card} mpé akúti kárti íbálá

phase.learning_complete: Mokanda yango esilaki, mpe ntango ya koyekola esili - mayele nyonso oyo etikali ezali na ntina mpo na kolonga.

draw.loser_received: Obungisaki mayele mabe mpe obimisaki {card} na liboke.

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Ba carte ezali na maboko te.

trick_view.empty: Ata moko te abɛtaki naino likɔnga yango.

board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Mokonzi {player_id}: {scoring} ekoki kozwama ({tricks} motó), {hand_size} kárti na bomwana

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
